content: All employees are entitled to 5 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than two days.
Employees with at least one year of service are entitled to 26 weeks of parental leave per child, requested at least 30 days in advance.
Earned leave accrues at 18 days per year after the first year. Up to 30 days may be carried forward.
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Fully remote requires director sign-off.
Core collaboration hours are 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time.
All full-time employees receive health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision from day one.
Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,000 USD.
The wellness program reimburses up to 50 USD per month for gym memberships or fitness apps.
Error code ERR-5021 indicates VPN authentication failure. Reset your VPN-7 profile from the self-service portal and retry. If ERR-5021 persists, file a ticket with the network team.
Laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. Submit Form IT-09 to request an early refresh for hardware faults.
Production database access requires approval ticket PROD-ACCESS-01 plus a hardware security key. Access expires after 90 days.
Form HR-26 is the parental leave application form. It must be submitted at least 30 days before the leave start date. Late submissions require director approval.
Form HR-11 covers reimbursement of relocation expenses up to 5,000 USD within the first 90 days of employment.
The compensation structure for senior leadership consists of base salary, an annual bonus of up to 60 percent, and a four-year equity grant vesting quarterly.
The CEO package includes a base of 480,000 USD, a performance bonus up to 100 percent, and additional equity refreshers approved by the board.
Engineering salary bands range from Band E1 at 65,000 USD to Band E7 at 280,000 USD, reviewed annually against market data.
Sales compensation is 60/40 base-to-variable with on-target earnings from 90,000 USD at S1 to 320,000 USD at S6.
